_comment: Bistro street walk on Quest, inside the PVS grid of the street-slab bakes (doc/plans/pvs.md step 8 and 'Verification'). The head moves on a 2 m straight line through the streaming section's pose 9 (cell 458 of the 4 m bake): from 1 m behind it to 1 m ahead of it along the view direction, at 2.2 m height looking 45 degrees left of -Z, over the 600 measured frames (the path is indexed by measured frame, a timedemo: the same frames every run; frame 600 is never reached, so the walk does not wrap inside the window). Run like benchmark_bistro.json: --editor-args --no-scene --bench-to-device --load-scene <device path of a Save for Quest Bistro file>.
name: bistro_street
